# === Dict builtins ===

--8<-- [start:is_dict_1]

--8<-- [end:is_dict_1]

--8<-- [start:dict_size_2]
dict_size(+Dict, -N)
--8<-- [end:dict_size_2]

--8<-- [start:dict_keys_2]
dict_keys(+Dict, -Keys)
--8<-- [end:dict_keys_2]

--8<-- [start:dict_values_2]
dict_values(+Dict, -Values)
--8<-- [end:dict_values_2]

--8<-- [start:dict_pairs_2]
dict_pairs(?Dict, ?Pairs)
--8<-- [end:dict_pairs_2]

--8<-- [start:dict_get_3]
dict_get(+Key, +Dict, ?Value)
--8<-- [end:dict_get_3]

--8<-- [start:dict_put_4]
dict_put(+Key, +Value, +OldDict, -NewDict)
--8<-- [end:dict_put_4]

--8<-- [start:dict_put_pairs_3]
dict_put_pairs(+Pairs, +OldDict, -NewDict)
--8<-- [end:dict_put_pairs_3]

--8<-- [start:dict_remove_3]
dict_remove(+Key, +OldDict, -NewDict)
--8<-- [end:dict_remove_3]

--8<-- [start:dict_merge_3]
dict_merge(+D1, +D2, -Merged)
--8<-- [end:dict_merge_3]

--8<-- [start:gen_dict_3]
gen_dict(?Key, +Dict, ?Value)
--8<-- [end:gen_dict_3]

--8<-- [start:sub_dict_2]
sub_dict(+Pattern, +Dict)
--8<-- [end:sub_dict_2]

--8<-- [start:atom_vs_string_keys]
-double_quotes(chars)
-private([k])            # a bare atom key must be declared (strict atoms)

# `k` bare and `'k'` quoted are both the ATOM key k; "k" is the STRING key.
config({k: 1}),          # atom key
labels({"k": 1}),        # string key -- a DIFFERENT dict

# config(D), labels(D)  fails: the two dicts do not unify.
# V is D[k]  and  V is D.k  both look up the ATOM key.
--8<-- [end:atom_vs_string_keys]
